exact_context_ids_reason: No panel selected or generated. Warm-start recovery blocker and unapproved exact geometry selection prevent freezing a faithful recurring panel.
context_identification_procedure: Read/hash retained accepted A summary, configuration, source inventory, raw plans, release_contexts and Planning/vehicle files; match to immutable manifest. Never invoke a numerical worker, solver, simulation or historical regeneration.

Propose controlled_A as the primary selection population (622 releases); measured_A_1 (620) is an alternate requiring explicit review. Do not pool them or select the faster run. Validate source/config/fixture parity and successful authority history from retained records.

Join by unique plan_id and exact prefix.release_time to raw release/event and active packet. Capture sampled state, estimate-at-release, target, tracker configuration/limits/previous command, actual previous application, pending control/time, active packet identity/contents/expiry/reserve, and chronology up to release only.

Recover the actual controller.solution X/U/slacks immediately BEFORE that preparation, its use_warm_start/reset history, previous_control and required terminal/reference configuration. A release-active packet is not necessarily the latest optimizer solution; rejected proposals and reset paths matter. Full slacks cannot be reconstructed from aggregate max/sum or replaced with zeros.

Before selecting IDs, review a geometry-only rule using frozen Planning curvature/progress interpolation: define straight/corner quantiles, sustained-corner dwell and entry/exit classification. Do not infer cost from solver timings, iterations or failure ranking. Freeze exact formula/units/quantile/tie rules and handle absent strata without fabrication.

Within each approved stratum order eligible releases by continuous progress then release_time/plan_id; choose four nearest to 20/40/60/80 percent of that stratum progress span, without replacement, ties to lower release_time then plan_id. Require four distinct contexts per stratum and twelve overall, including reviewed entry and exit coverage. If unavailable, stop selection and request a protocol amendment.

Write a new compact manifest with source run IDs, file SHA256s, JSON pointers, exact context IDs/times/progress, geometry classification, full causal-context digest and warm/cold provenance. Hash exact artifact bytes; never rewrite retained source records.

Engineering reviews the selected contexts and verifies recoverability before any execution. If warm starts are unavailable, block the faithful recurring panel; a cold-start diagnostic alternative needs explicit amendment, must be labelled cold and cannot establish recurring preparation cost.
